name: Extract personal data with a self-hosted LLM Mistral NeMo

parameters.content:
## Communication record extraction

Edit Set Communication Text and connect Ollama Chat Model to a service with mistral-nemo:latest. The shared model uses temperature 0.1 and n8n keepAlive 2h. Native model adapters may retry transient request failures.

A valid first completion returns the record. Invalid JSON or fields get one correction step, then return an extracted or failed result. Model request failures use the failure paths and never trigger a format correction without a completion. Current-time context is UTC. Verify extracted contacts against submitted text. No contact system is modified.
